displayTitle: Revenge of the Sith: The 20th Anniversary Special Edition
synopsis: This hardcover volume features a behind-the-scenes look at the making of Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith, from script development to concept art and costume designs, through to filming and eventual release. Lavishly illustrated with photography and art from the Lucasfilm Archives, this must-have collector's edition also includes vintage interviews with stars Hayden Christensen, Ewan McGregor, and Natalie Portman
title: Revenge of the Sith: The 20th Anniversary Special Edition
